_comment: Shared expectations for phone normalization. The TypeScript implementation (lib/order-utils.ts normalizePhoneForSearch) and the SQL generated column orders.normalized_phone must BOTH satisfy every case. Synthetic numbers only - never put real customer phones here. Shapes chosen to cover every class present in live data: leading-zero (20,223 rows), +964/964 country code (1,732), separators, plus classes that do not occur today (Arabic-Indic digits, 00964) so the two implementations stay pinned together if they ever appear.

cases.why: Arabic-Indic digits - absent from live data, pinned anyway

00 international access code is stripped first, so the 964 country code is then visible and removed. Fixed 2026-09-09 in BOTH implementations together (TS + migration 20260909100000, which also REINDEXes idx_orders_tenant_normphone). 0 live rows use this shape.
00 is stripped, and what follows is left alone when it is not the 964 country code
964 stripped first, then the leading zero it exposes
